articles.title: Binance withdraws Greek MiCA bid but vows to remain in Europe
articles.snippet: The crypto giant must find a home base in the EU by July 1 or regulators will force the company to shut down operations for millions of regional users.

articles.title: Bitcoin falls below $60,000 as AI trade continues to draw investor interest and capital
articles.snippet: South Korean memory chip giant on Wednesday filed to raise nearly $30 billion in a U.S. offering.

articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: Infrastructure is the prevailing currency in digital assets
articles.snippet: In this week's Crypto Long & Short, Nonco’s Caue Teixeira makes the case that regardless of which coin ultimately wins, infrastructure is the prevailing currency in digital assets. Then, using CoinDesk's liquidation feed, Liquibit Capital's Alen Pavlović finds that June's forced selling peaked near $68,000, days before bitcoin actually bottomed.

articles.title: SecondFi loses $2.4 million in Cardano wallet exploit
articles.snippet: SecondFi was hit by three separate attacks exploiting a flaw in its wallet generation software. A further 129 million ADA was secured by the team before attackers could reach it.

articles.title: Trump's refusal to sign housing bill could delay Congress and imperil Clarity Act
articles.snippet: As Congress prepared to celebrate the president's signing of the bipartisan housing bill that contains a CBDC prohibition, Trump abruptly cancelled the event.
